Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-canoe-seakayak/

Paddle a wooden sea kayak made from locally sourced timber and explore the rich natural surroundings of Naguri Lake on this eco-tour.

【Fee】
6,000 yen per person (includes guide, insurance, kayak rental, food, etc.)

【Capacity】
2 two-person kayaks

【Guide】
Staff from Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop

【What to bring】
Drink, towel, change of clothes (you may get wet), clothes that are okay to get wet, and sun protection items such as hat or sunglasses as needed.

【More information】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
